title: Core Market Mechanics
subtitle: Ownership, Orders & Market Capitalization
description: Understand what a share of equity represents, how supply and demand establish market price on the exchange, and how market cap differentiates company scale.

title: Financial Literacy & Quality
subtitle: Revenue, Earnings Quality, Capital Efficiency & Leverage
description: Learn to inspect company performance: top-line revenue, net profit vs operating cash flow, EPS, P/E multiple nuances, Return on Equity (ROE), and debt solvency.

title: Valuation & Price Context
subtitle: 52-Week Ranges, Growth & Peer Comparison
description: Evaluate historical price positioning using 52-week high/low ranges, measure durable revenue growth, and perform objective peer group comparisons.

title: Trend & Stage Analysis
subtitle: Moving Averages, Volume & Market Cycles
description: Separate distinct trend methodologies: Stan Weinstein's 4-stage lifecycle (with 30-week MA ≈ 150 trading days), moving-average alignment, and price-volume characteristics.

title: Structural Bases & Candidate Screening
subtitle: Contraction Patterns & Accumulation Signatures
description: Distinguish screener candidates from structural pattern confirmation: consolidation bases, Stockerboard VCP candidate heuristics, and Pocket Pivot volume criteria.

title: Risk Frameworks & Mathematical Expectancy
subtitle: Position Sizing, Expectancy & Execution Models
description: Master strategy-dependent risk-per-trade budgeting, theoretical trade expectancy equations, and comparative exit models (fixed R, scale-out, trailing stop, invalidation).
